definition: Hydrocarbon release frequency from valve leaks (stem, body, gland)
rationale: Total release frequencies of order 0.1-1 per installation-year (all sizes) appear in public offshore release statistics (e.g. UK HSE hydrocarbon release reporting, IOGP Risk Assessment Data Directory). The split by cause is an assumption.

definition: Release frequency from flanges, seals and small-bore fittings
rationale: Flanges and small-bore connections are typically the most numerous leak sources; given the largest share (assumption).

definition: Release frequency from pipework corrosion/erosion at nominal inspection effectiveness
rationale: Smaller share than mechanical joints; sensitive to inspection programme (see inspection mitigation).

definition: Breaking-containment jobs under permit-to-work per platform-year
rationale: Roughly three per week per processing platform (assumption).

definition: Probability a breaking-containment job has an isolation/PTW failure (wrong isolation, not proven, procedural deviation)
rationale: Order 1e-3 per task is a common human-error screening value for procedural steps with checks; wide prior.

definition: Probability an isolation failure results in a hydrocarbon release
rationale: Many isolation errors are caught at pressure test or bleed-down before a release.

definition: Rate of process upsets demanding pressure protection
rationale: Blocked outlets, control-valve failures; assumption.

definition: Probability pressure protection (PSV/HIPPS) fails on demand, leading to loss of containment
rationale: Treated as a single protection layer of roughly SIL 2 equivalent (assumption).

definition: Fraction of releases that are large (> ~10 kg/s)
rationale: Public release statistics are dominated by small releases; a few percent are major (assumption within that pattern).

definition: Fraction of releases that are medium (~1-10 kg/s)
rationale: Remainder after large are small.

definition: Probability a small release reaches enough gas detectors to trigger (geometric coverage)
rationale: Small releases often dilute below detector thresholds; coverage, not hardware, usually limits detection.

definition: Gas detection coverage for medium releases
rationale: Assumption.

definition: Gas detection coverage for large releases
rationale: Large clouds nearly always reach several detectors.

definition: Dangerous-undetected failure rate of a point gas detector
rationale: Order 1e-6/h is typical of the range in reliability handbooks such as OREDA; value is an assumption.

definition: Beta-factor for common-cause failure of gas detectors in one zone
rationale: Beta factors of 1-10 % are the usual range in beta-factor CCF modelling (e.g. IEC 61508-6 Annex D scheme).

definition: Dangerous-undetected failure rate of a flame detector
rationale: As gas detectors.

definition: Beta-factor for flame detectors in one zone
rationale: As gas detectors.

definition: PFD of the fire & gas / ESD logic solver
rationale: Certified safety PLC; small compared with field devices.

definition: Dangerous-undetected failure rate of an ESD valve (fail to close)
rationale: Order 1e-6/h for actuated valves; assumption.

definition: Beta-factor for common-cause failure of the two ESD valves
rationale: Identical valves, same fluid and maintenance crew -> upper part of the usual range.

definition: Proof-test interval for detectors, ESD valves and deluge valves
rationale: Annual full proof test (assumption).

definition: Probability operators fail to activate deluge manually when automatic fire detection fails
rationale: Manual activation under stress with delayed awareness; judgement.

definition: Dangerous-undetected failure rate of a deluge valve set (fail to open / blocked nozzles)
rationale: Deluge valve tests commonly reveal failures; assumption.

definition: Probability an electric-motor firewater pump fails to start on demand
rationale: Generic prior; optionally replaced by the Beta posterior from synthetic weekly start tests.

definition: Probability the diesel-driven standby firewater pump fails to start on demand
rationale: Diesel drivers are generally less reliable to start than electric motors; generic prior updated with synthetic tests.

definition: Fraction of time a firewater pump is out of service for maintenance
rationale: About one week per year per pump.

definition: Firewater pump fail-to-run rate during a fire
rationale: Combined with a 6 h mission time.

definition: Required firewater run time during a fire
rationale: Duration of a sustained fire until inventory is blown down and fire is out.

definition: Beta-factor for common-cause failure to start of the two electric firewater pumps
rationale: Same room, same switchboard, same maintenance -> high beta.

definition: Probability the firewater ring main/header cannot deliver (impaired section, blockage, closed isolation valve)
rationale: Single series element for all pumps; very uncertain.

definition: Ignition probability of a small, unisolated release
rationale: Ignition probability rises with release rate; published ignition models (e.g. IOGP RADD ignition data) give values of order 1 % for small and 10 %+ for large releases.

definition: Ignition probability of a medium, unisolated release
rationale: See p_ign_small.

definition: Ignition probability of a large, unisolated release
rationale: See p_ign_small.

definition: Multiplier on ignition probability when the release is isolated (shorter duration, smaller cloud)
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Probability an ignited small gas release leads to an explosion (delayed ignition in congestion)
rationale: Small clouds rarely reach congested volumes of significance.

definition: Explosion probability given ignition, medium gas release
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Explosion probability given ignition, large gas release
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Multiplier on explosion probability for liquid (two-phase / oil) releases
rationale: Liquid releases mainly give pool fires; flashing fraction can still explode.

definition: Probability the emergency response to a fire/explosion is materially delayed
rationale: Judgement (night shift, muster issues, communication failure).

definition: Multiplier on escalation probability when response is delayed
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Probability a major fire escalates across one bridge to an adjacent platform
rationale: Bridges provide separation distance; escalation requires prolonged impingement.

definition: Probability an explosion escalates to an adjacent platform
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Probability a catastrophic event escalates to an adjacent platform
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Weibull (power-law NHPP) shape parameter for compressor train failures
rationale: Shape > 1 represents wear-out between overhauls.

definition: Weibull scale (years since overhaul at which expected cumulative failures = 1)
rationale: Gives roughly 0.3-0.5 failures per train-year at mid-cycle.

definition: Age of compressor trains since last major overhaul at the start of the year
rationale: Mid-way through a ~4 year overhaul cycle.

definition: Fraction of complex production lost while one compressor train is down
rationale: Gas handling constraint forces choke-back (flaring limits).

definition: Median repair duration of a compressor failure
rationale: Depends on spares availability.

definition: Failure/trip rate of one gas-turbine generator
rationale: Of order one forced outage per machine-year including trips; assumption.

definition: Mean time to restore a failed generator
rationale: Most trips are restarted in hours; some need parts.

definition: Beta-factor for common-cause loss of all generators (fuel gas, control system, switchboard)
rationale: Shared fuel gas and switchboard.

definition: Median time to restore production after a total power loss
rationale: Black start, restart sequence.

definition: Export pipeline loss-of-containment frequency
rationale: Order 1e-4 to 1e-3 per km-year is the range suggested by public pipeline loss-of-containment compilations (e.g. PARLOC-type studies); value is an assumption.

definition: Median outage duration for an export pipeline repair
rationale: Mobilising a repair spread and clamp.

definition: Median direct repair cost of a pipeline failure
rationale: Vessel spread and repair clamp.

definition: Rate of spurious platform trips (instrument failures, procedural deviations)
rationale: Several unplanned trips per year across the complex is typical of mature assets (judgement).

definition: Rate of extreme weather events requiring precautionary shut-in and de-manning
rationale: Fictional basin with a cyclone season.

definition: Probability an extreme weather event causes structural/topsides damage
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Rate of significant vessel impacts on the complex
rationale: Mostly attendant/supply vessel impacts.

definition: Probability a collision ruptures a riser, giving a large hydrocarbon release on WHP
rationale: Riser guards reduce but do not remove this.

definition: Median platform downtime after a minor (controlled) fire
rationale: Investigation, repair of local damage.

definition: Median platform downtime after a major fire
rationale: Replacement of damaged modules, cabling, structural checks.

definition: Median platform downtime after an explosion
rationale: Blast damage to structure and equipment.

definition: Median platform downtime after a catastrophic event
rationale: Major rebuild.

definition: Median downtime of a platform damaged by escalation from a neighbour
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Mean damage fraction (of platform replacement value) for a major fire
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Mean damage fraction for an explosion
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Mean damage fraction for a catastrophic event
rationale: Judgement.

definition: Economic loss per deferred barrel as a fraction of the oil price
rationale: Deferred production is partly recovered later; bundles time value, permanent loss and avoided variable cost.

definition: Actual production relative to nominal platform capacity
rationale: Reservoir performance uncertainty over the year.
